# `html_table`

HTML tables for the docs site.

Usage: `from textkit.formats.html_table import render`

Sample output:

```
<table>
<thead><tr><th>sku</th><th>name</th><th>qty</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>W-1</td><td>Widget</td><td>3</td></tr>
<tr><td>G-2</td><td>Gadget, large</td><td></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
```
